2609.35047.title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
2609.35047.paper_summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
2609.35047.paper_summary_zh: 機器人應能透過實驗學習不熟悉物體的行為和互動，然後利用這些知識進行規劃。它不必從零開始：物理引擎提供運動和接觸的知識，但可以省略整個機制，例如膠水固化、水加熱或風。我們提出了EMPIRIC，一個學習殘餘世界模型的智能體：一個擴展了缺失機制代碼的物理引擎。學習到的程序可以引入新的力量、約束和隱藏狀態，貝葉斯推斷從嘈雜的觀察中估計它們的參數和狀態。所得到的模型使智能體能夠預測行動的結果，選擇有意義的實驗，並在預測失敗時修正其假設。在五個模擬領域中，EMPIRIC學習可解釋的、可重用的模型，並以比所有三個基準更少的環境互動解決更多任務。在一個物理機器人上，它學習風力和多米諾骨牌的質量以解決操作任務。網站和代碼：https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
